name: DawsonyWeb Label and Document Designer for WooCommerce
author: DawsonyWeb

sections.description:
Print product barcode labels directly from your WooCommerce catalogue, or create address labels and packing slips from orders. Pick a starter layout, drag in the fields you need and preview it with an existing order. Generate a PDF for your thermal label stock or an A4 or Letter sheet, then print it at actual size.

What you can do with Free

  • Label stock without an order. Find products by name, exact SKU or ID, select individual variations and set copies for each. Print up to 20 products or variations and 100 labels per PDF. Use Products > Bulk actions > Print product labels or choose Product catalogue in the designer. Stock levels and orders stay unchanged.

  • Print address and product labels. Add shipping and billing details, product names, SKUs, order fields and supported custom fields. Use Code 128, EAN or QR codes where appropriate.

  • Fit your label stock. Set dimensions in millimetres or inches. Use common A4 sticker-sheet layouts, set margins and gaps, and start at the next unused label on a sheet. A calibration PDF helps you check printer offsets.
  • Create packing slips, delivery notes and job sheets. Choose the product columns and add your own header and footer. Long order tables continue across pages.
  • Save a layout for next time. Start from a ready-made design or build your own. Edit layers, align elements, undo changes and import or export templates as JSON.
  • Generate PDFs manually. Choose one label per order, item or whole-number quantity, or combine a batch within the manual PDF limits. PDFs are generated on your own site.

See it in use

Print product barcode labels from WooCommerce order items

Print shipping address labels from an order

Set up and print an A4 sticker sheet

These videos use the Free plugin and sample orders. Read the setup guide and download sample templates.

When you need automation or invoices

Label and Document Designer Pro is a separate add-on. It can generate PDFs in the background when orders match your rules, keep a private document history and send a PDF by email or put it in a manual print queue. It also adds numbered PDF invoices, refund-linked credit notes, customer account downloads and ZIP export. Explore a fictional order workflow in the Free & Pro tab before deciding.

External services and privacy

Free generates PDFs locally. It does not send analytics, licence checks or order data to dawsony.com and does not load remote scripts, fonts or images. Links open only when clicked. Templates stay in your WordPress database and the plugin does not retain the PDFs it returns to your browser. Store and share PDFs containing customer details securely.

Source code and build instructions

The archive includes editable JavaScript in resources/, dependency lockfiles and instructions in BUILDING.txt. The PHP dependency build tools are in tools/ and dependency notices are in THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt.
sections.installation:
1. Activate WooCommerce and make sure PHP mbstring is enabled.
  2. In Plugins > Add New, search for DawsonyWeb Label and Document Designer. Install and activate it on the site.
  3. Open Labels & Docs and choose a starter label. For paperwork, use Designer > New document and choose a packing slip, delivery note or job sheet.
  4. Pick a preview order, adjust the layout and save your template.
  5. Generate one PDF first. Print at actual size (100%) and measure or scan the sample before printing a batch.
sections.faq:
Can I print shipping labels or buy postage?

You can print address and dispatch labels using the shipping details on a WooCommerce order. Book postage and generate any carrier-approved postage or tracking label separately.

Can I print product barcodes?

Yes. Select a WooCommerce order, choose Current item and bind the barcode to an SKU or another supported field. Code 128 works with ordinary alphanumeric SKUs. EAN requires a valid identifier and check digit. Choose Product catalogue for labels without an order, or use selected order items. Variable products open their individual variations. Catalogue mode uses product fields and copy counts; order fields and documents need an order. Always scan a physical sample before printing a batch.

Can I use a thermal printer or A4 sticker sheets?

Set the PDF size to match your label stock or arrange labels on a sheet with margins and gaps. Use your printer driver to print at actual size. Printer compatibility, offsets and borderless output depend on the printer and stock. The plugin generates a PDF rather than sending a job directly to hardware.

Can I create packing slips or PDF invoices?

Free includes manual packing slips, delivery notes and job sheets. Product tables can continue over several pages with repeating headers. The separate Pro add-on issues numbered PDF invoices and credit notes. Draft previews do not issue numbers. Credit notes require an actual WooCommerce refund and the original invoice. Review your seller details, layout and tax treatment before issuing.

What happens to issued invoices in Pro?

Pro preserves the original PDF and the fields used to create it. Later edits to the order do not rewrite it. Issued invoices and credit notes use their own register and do not expire with operational PDFs. Order deletion does not remove that register. Export any records you need before choosing to remove plugin data.

Does it work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin uses WooCommerce’s order APIs and supports HPOS and legacy order storage.

Can I reuse a template on another site?

Yes. Export the template as JSON and import it into the designer on the other site. Re-select any local Media Library images there.

What are the batch and design limits?

Free supports up to 20 orders or 100 labels per manual order PDF. Catalogue PDFs support up to 20 products or variations and 100 labels, 200 saved templates, 100 elements per template and page dimensions from 10 to 500 mm. Document batches support up to 300 pages and 2,000 lines per order. Text that cannot fit stops PDF generation with an error. Designs can extend past the edge, but content outside each label is cropped. Keep barcodes inside the printable area.

What happens on uninstall?

Templates are kept by default. To remove the plugin’s data, including retained Pro documents and invoices, explicitly set the printrelay_delete_data option to 1 before uninstalling. Back up first. Network-wide activation is unsupported.

Where can I get help?

Use Help & tour in Labels & Docs or follow the documentation. For Free support, use the WordPress.org support forum.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Added product-catalogue label printing without an order, with product and variation selection, SKU/name/ID search and per-product copy counts.
  • Added a Products bulk action and a catalogue barcode starter. Existing sheet presets, calibration and partly used sheets work with catalogue labels.
  • Added guarded catalogue preview and PDF routes. Printing leaves stock and orders unchanged; order-bound layouts are rejected in catalogue mode.

1.2.3

  • Explore how Pro handles order events in a fictional-order walkthrough inside the Free & Pro tab. The walkthrough runs locally and does not create jobs or read customer data.

1.2.2

  • Improved plugin directory listing and documentation. Updated relevant directory tags. No functionality changes.

1.2.1

  • Improved plugin directory listing and documentation. Added three step-by-step video tutorials for barcode labels, shipping address labels and A4 sticker sheets. No functionality changes.

1.2.0

  • Expanded the shared designer with packing slips, delivery notes and job sheets, configurable tables and multi-page documents.
  • Added Pro invoice and credit-note issuing with preserved original PDFs, separate retention, account downloads, order email attachments and ZIP export.
  • Added document starter layouts and clearer Free and Pro guidance. Existing label templates and plugin identifiers are unchanged.
  • Preserved intentional spaces in prefix and suffix formatters.

1.1.5

  • Updated the plugin display name with distinctive DawsonyWeb branding. No functionality changes.

1.1.4

  • Added an optional Free and Pro comparison with setup links and clearer automation benefits.
  • Added a plugin-list shortcut to the comparison. Existing Free features are unchanged.

1.1.3

  • Added automatic canvas fitting and three common A4 sheet presets, available in Free and Pro.
  • Fixed bundled font loading, mobile layouts, preview feedback and combined-order state.
  • Improved recovery from expired sessions, failed template loads and unexpected server responses.
  • Shortened the admin menu to Label Designer and clarified batch limits.
  • Improved Pro rule validation and trigger summaries; hid the Pro promotion when Pro is active.

1.1.2

  • Improved plugin directory listing and documentation.

1.1.1

  • Updated the public plugin name and listing text. No feature, settings or data changes.

1.1.0

  • Added rotation-aware edge and centre alignment, element geometry locks and whole-template duplication.
  • Added optional shrink-to-fit text with a minimum font size and preview overflow warnings.
  • Added per-template printer offsets and a customer-free calibration PDF.
  • Updated the built-in guide. Pro remains a separate add-on.

1.0.4

The design canvas no longer shifts when selecting or dragging elements: the Element properties panel now scrolls within the workspace. The element Delete button is now red.

1.0.3

Aligned the display name with the DawsonyWeb plugin collection. Existing plugin identifiers, templates and settings are unchanged.

1.0.2

First WordPress.org release. Fixed preview order searches on sites using Plain permalinks. Added listing screenshots and expanded installation guidance.

1.0.1

Renamed to Dawsony Product & Shipping Label Designer for WooCommerce. Existing templates, settings and extension hooks are retained.

1.0.0

Separated Free designer/manual PDF functionality from the Pro automation add-on. Preserved existing templates and internal extension identifiers.
